question: Find the ID and age of the patient diagnosed with SJS who has an elevated triglyceride level (above 200), a normal creatinine level (below 1.5), and the highest anti-Cardiolipin IgA antibody concentration among all such patients.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058", STRFTIME('%Y', DATE('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060")
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_064" = 'SJS'
  AND T2."XCL_047" > 200
  AND T2."XCL_056" < 1.5
ORDER BY T2."XCL_043" DESC
LIMIT 1
